text: I always remember you and think about you, my sister Sophie. I knew you through Jihad Hattab and you were my favorite couple. I always miss you being friends and your videos together. I don’t know what happened to make you change and move away, but I think you must fix the dispute between you because we miss you life and death. They cannot be controlled, and no one should leave this world quarreling with the other. I hope you reconsider all your beautiful memories, and I hope that you will try to communicate together and fix what happened. In the end, if you do not like my words, I am sorry. I wanted to express what I feel It's been years you really have to come back❤
